answer: Each agent reserves 1,000 compute-slots as a capacity kernel to anchor an echo of exclusive task cycles within a trusted registry. The system acts as a vertex to verify that no two slots overlap, slashing any agent found with duplicate claims. Honest participants pay one slot fee, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fake identities incurs 1,000 times that cost. Reservations lock for one epoch with no refund on collisions.
